en-US.longDescription: NoSQLBooster for MongoDB (formerly MongoBooster) is a shell-centric cross-platform GUI tool for MongoDB v2.6-4.4, which provides comprehensive server monitoring tools, fluent query builder, SQL query, query code, task scheduling, ESNext support, and true IntelliSense experience.
